Dialogs.Dialog: Look, the fountain water. It's all sparkly.
Hey, your eyes are half shut？ Want to take a little nap on the grass？
Ah... Yeah. Thanks. But won't you get bored, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Not at all. Because I have an important job.
Yes. I've always wanted to... give you a lap pillow. Come on, let's go？
Yes. We're just walking side by side like this... so why is it so fun, I wonder.
...That question mark was unnecessary. As punishment, you can't let go of my hand for the rest of the day！
Do you want to draw a fortune？
Even without the fortune telling, I can say that I'm very happy the way things are now.
Cobblestones are hard to walk on, huh.
...At times like this, if you took my hand, I'd think you were even more wonderful, you know？
...I shall improve. Ahem. Your hand, princess.
Apparently shrines are best visited in the morning.
Visiting at night is bad news. Plus, you know, something might show up！
True, night doesn't sound good, does it？ Even if ghosts aren't a problem.
What did you think about the movie？
It was fun！ I might want to see more like that.
I see. Yeah, let's come again.
Mm... Sorry, I don't really remember it.
No. I wasn't sleepy, but instead of the movie, you, next to me...
...It's your fault, you know？ Doing things that distract me.
What did you think about the movie？
Well... that kind of thing isn't really...
Sorry. Next time, I'd like to see something different？
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Does your hand hurt, maybe？
Geez. ...I don't lose to you on that either, you know.
When you were little, didn't you bowl on lanes without gutters？
Oh, yeah, yeah！ It turns into billiards.
Yes. Apparently I gave Papa a hard time insisting on a normal lane.
And then the ball didn't reach the pins and I cried from frustration... It's so embarrassing now.
(Hates losing, as expected... Not much different from now？)
Nice strike！ All right, here I go too.
You got it！ I'm going to beat ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
...That's not allowed. I'm absolutely not losing.
It was really lively, wasn't it？ I think I like that kind of thing. It's fun.
(Note: ▲高嶺＊＊▲ likes that kind of thing.)
Live houses make you a little nervous, don't they？ Somehow.
Yes. I feel out of place. ...Hey, can we hold hands？
That kind of thing isn't really for me... I think.
If possible, next time I'd like to come for a different show.
(Note: ▲高嶺＊＊▲ isn't into that kind of thing.)
Do you have perfect pitch, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes, I think I do？ ...Oh, don't.
You were about to tap the glasses, weren't you？ ...Even with that sad face, no-o.
...Actually, I'm not great at this. I don't know what to do when I'm not singing.
And when I'm singing, I feel people looking... Especially with you, my heart pounds.
Then should I not look much？
▲高嶺＊＊▲, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Sing this one, this.
"First new album in three years, and its top track hits #1 again this week！" ...That idol song？ Right？
Hehe！ Leave it to me. I've got it down perfectly.
▲主人公＊▲. Can I sit next to you？
！ Maybe I shouldn't... If I sit next to you and the car tilts...
Kya！ Maybe next to you after all... But...！
(We'll be back down before she decides...)
Yeah, that went by in a flash.
Hey？ Want to come at night next time？
Sounds good. Let's come soon, then.
I wish it were a little scarier.
You're cool as a cucumber, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
It's surprising, but not scary... I think？ I can tell where the gimmicks are and where people are hiding.
I'm kind of missing out, aren't I？ I envy people who can just enjoy it.
Oh yeah. Remember that part with the row of doors？ Apparently something really shows up there.
...Geez！ Why didn't you tell me before？ If I'd known, I'd have looked more carefully！
Huh？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲, aren't you good with thrill rides？
No. Once I'm on, I'm fine. It's so fun I end up laughing.
But getting there is the problem. I just get so nervous...
Hey... can I hold your arm？ Help me calm down？
(She wants to ride it that badly...)
That was so windy... Hey, is my hair weird？
...Geez. At times like this, just let it slide.
(Yep, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ should be just like that！)
Yeah. I could lose track of time.
...Shall we lose track of it？ Just kidding？
All right. Mow them down！ Just kidding. Hehe！
"Mistress" is a bit... At least "Your Majesty" or "Princess" would be nicer？
Don't let go of my hand so we don't get separated, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Okay. ...You have a really strong grip, don't you？
S-Sorry. Did I squeeze too hard？
No. It makes me feel really cherished... I'm happy. ...Hehe.
Are you okay!? Geez... I told you not to run.
Next time you're about to fall, fall toward me, okay？ I'll catch you▼
(Yes！ But I think we'd both go down...)
Hehe. You don't have to be flustered like that.
If you're going to look, do it openly. ...Even if it's at someone other than me.
Yes. I got a little chilled, so want to go to the jacuzzi？
Sounds good. Like a mixed bath all to ourselves！ ...Hm？ What's up？
...It's because you said something weird. Hmph.
(She really fell asleep. A ▲高嶺＊＊▲ like this is pretty rare.)
If you want to see a sky full of stars, I guess you can't around here.
Up in the mountains, you probably could？
But if I can be with you, it doesn't matter if they are artificial or real stars... Kind of.
I do？ ...Lots that could come true with you.
So many the stars might be overwhelmed. Hehe.
Hmm？ Whoa, it's huge！ Is this really a fruit!?
Yes. It's the biggest fruit in the world, and ripe ones are supposed to be sweet！ I'd love to just once... Why are you laughing？
Nothing. That's just so like you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
It's so comfortable it's making me sleepy.
Hehe. Want to take a break on the bench？
Great idea. Oh, and while we're at it, a lap pillow...
Don't get carried away so fast.
It's always quiet here, isn't it？
Yeah, it never seems crowded. It's just the two of us now.
Yes. ...Hey, could you stay still like that？ ...Oh.
Someone's coming. Too bad. Next time？
(What were you going to do, ▲高嶺＊＊▲!?)
It was great. Hey, let's come again？
You really love it now, huh？ Okay, promise.
Yes, a little. Since this morning... well, since last night, I've been really wound up.
Geez, because it's a date with you.
I thought I could have fun anywhere with you, but...
Yeahhh. Boats going under the bridge...
Watching them together, talking about nothing like we are now...
Maybe this is what happiness is...
Did you know？ When they get a bit bigger, you can eat them. They taste like crab. So good！
Yes. Papa caught some once... and since then, I keep thinking "Are those almost ready to eat？"▼
(So ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s appetite comes from her dad？)
That bridge always looks so magnificent...
When you look up at stuff like this, your mouth just falls open for some reason.
！ Was I making a weird face？
Geez, teasing me again... So don't look.
Hey！ Want to go buy yakisoba at the beach hut later？
Sure, but... we came here to swim, right, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes, of course. Oh, and hot dogs are hard to pass up too, aren't they？
I need to put on sunscreen soon.
Huh？ You didn't put it on at home？
It comes off when you sweat or go in the water. So...
Okay, leave it to me！ Your back？ O-Or maybe...
A place like this calls for precautions, doesn't it？
Yes. But for you, maybe a blindfold.
Hehe. They say the eyes speak louder than words. It's true▼
No one's here in the off-season.
I like it better like this, though.
Because I'm with you... Geez, that face！ You knew and made me say it. Meanie！
Ta-da！ Introducing the human heat pack. Come, into my arms！
...But maybe I'll use it without holding back？ Though it might get hot rather than warm.
I wonder if there are any shells here？
Like cherry blossom shells？ Oh, don't tell me you're after clams？
No. That reminds me, when I was little, a friend mistook my toenails for cherry shells and grabbed my foot.
They're that pretty？ Lucky. I want to see ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s feet too...
...Your eyes look scary, so I'm not showing you. Look the other way.
What do you think it's thinking about while it swims？
Maybe about food？ Hehe, its mouth keeps opening and closing.
No！ I'm watching a little longer！
Stop！ It looks just like it... Hehehe！
...Aha！ Geez, I'll just cling to you so I can't see your face▼
(Huh？ Didn't see that coming... Well, I'll take it.)
Hehe. They're taking tottering steps. So cute▼
Yeah. If people did that, it wouldn't look like that... Hm？
Yeah, it might be cute▼ Try it？
Hehe, if I could swim like that, I'd win medals. What would you do if I got famous？
I swear I'd stay by ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s side, same as always！ ...Just kidding.
Y-You can't say that out of nowhere, it's not fair！ ...Geez.
It really feels like we're underwater... But if I'm not careful, I might get queasy.
Yeah, it's all refracted. Twisted, like.
N-No！ The light gets bent, and... I mean the acrylic curves, like...
Kidding. Geez, it was just a little joke, right？
Oh no, I'm soaked. Dolphin jumps are amazing, huh？
Here, a handkerchief. You should dry off.
No, I mean, look. Your clothes...
That little girl looked so happy touching the dolphin.
Do you want to touch one, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes... but it's a lottery, isn't it？ I probably won't get picked...
Then we sign up every time we come. Until we win, the two of us.
...I see. Yes, you're right. Thank you.
...That's true, but isn't there a nicer way to put it？
Hmm, then... smells like dried fish！ Nicely aged...
...Geez！ I'm always laughing when I'm with you... If my smile gets stuck, it's your fault, okay？
Oh, they sell churros. Want some while we're here？
Eh？ You've never heard of it？ I think it's quite a popular snack.
...I know them？ Churros. Um, a fried snack... right！ Yes.
(I can't believe ▲高嶺＊＊▲ doesn't know churros...)
Oh, a cute woof-woof！ Out for a walk？
Huh？ ...Oh！ No, I meant to say "doggy"...
It's cute. Woof-woof. And cats are meow-meows！
Where we live would fit in a square made with your fingers.
Yes. In such a tiny little garden... maybe us meeting wasn't a coincidence after all？
...Just kidding. Hey, where do you think the school is？
Oh. There's a glass floor. Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
Huh？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲, you're not good with heights？
I'm not bad with them？ I like views. It's just, when it's like that under my feet, I get this tight feeling, okay？
Hey, the souvenir coin machine's free？
If we made one every time we came, how many would we end up with？
Way too many to count, obviously.
...Hehe！ I'm looking forward to see them▼
Hmm... what should I do？ I can't decide. Hey, give me a push？
...Your taste is what I want. So, please？
(What's up with ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ She won't come out of the fitting room...)
What happened to the clothes you took in？
Starting tomorrow... no, starting today, I have to cut back on sweets... Sigh...
There are so many kinds of nail polish, huh？
Yeah. Come to think of it, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ doesn't wear nail polish.
I just buff my nails. That alone makes them pretty, and getting them smooth is fun.
Here, touch them？ ...See？ Don't they feel nice？
(I can just picture ▲高嶺＊＊▲ buffing away, totally absorbed...)
It's nice. When I smell it around town, I think, "Oh, it's ▲高嶺＊＊▲."
I'll keep using the same one forever, then▼
Such a pretty ring... This one is also cute▼
Mm... just the mood is enough today, I think？ Hehe！
Huh. So you can give one as a present without knowing the size. Handy...
You can rent bikes here, huh？
Oh, you're right. Let's rent some and race！
Not a race. I'd rather take it easy and enjoy it.
Because I like doing that with you. Hehe.
Yeah. It's all sparkly in the sunset.
But the crows are cawing, so it's time to go home...
Let's hold hands, okay？ Come here, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Do swan boats only come in that shape？
There could be more shapes. Like a bunny.
...Oh！ Um... right？ I knew that, of course？
This place is a hidden gem. You can take your time with the view and just relax.
But I wonder why. Such a nice place, and nobody's here.
...Actually, this ship, see？ Long ago, pirates attacked it, and every night the crew's spirits...
I don't think so？ This is a lake. Oh, but if the ship was bought secondhand, maybe？
It feels good to stand in the front！ The wind, the scenery-- Kyaa！
A-Are you okay!? Phew... It's dangerous when it rocks like that, so hold on tight！
If I had a big brother, maybe it'd feel like this. Thank you, big brother. Hehe.
The wind feels great！ If I spread my arms on the prow, I feel like I could fly.
There's a scene like that in some movie, right？ The girl, and from behind, her boyfriend...
If I imagined myself in it, um... No, never mind.
(If she just said it casually, I wouldn't get embarrassed either...)
Hiking takes more stamina than you'd think, huh？
Yeah. Makes the food taste great！
Even more than that, right？ Hehe▼
Lots of people out picking wild greens... Don't you want to, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes, I'd like to, but I'm not sure I could tell them apart. And...
I'd get so into picking them, I'd end up ignoring you. So maybe I'll do it when I'm alone？
(True. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ does get hooked on things.)
Haa～... We walked a lot. Let's take a break.
Okay. ...Here, honey-pickled lemons. They should help with the fatigue.
Nice！ ▲高嶺＊＊▲ would make a great wife.
Geez... saying that here... Give me back the lemon.
(Aww, I didn't even get to eat it...)
Even when you know why leaves change color, it's still amazing, isn't it？
Yes. When I was little, I thought they turned red to stay warm because it was getting cold.
If I could go back to when I believed things that simply, I'd enjoy so much more.
...You'll laugh and laugh and not be able to stop, you know？
...Just kidding. Sorry？ Sometimes I want to see your surprised face. Hehehe！
You've gotten much better at skiing, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Hehe, I'm so happy！ It's thanks to my great coach, I guess？
...You've been stuck with me the whole time. If you want to ski the advanced course, don't hold back, okay？
If I feel like it. Right now I don't want to leave ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s side.
That skier who just went by looked great. Long hair flying... Bet they're popular.
...Here's someone else who's been captivated, huh？
Me!? That was a guy, I'm not into him like that... Hm？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
...Nothing. I didn't misunderstand anything at all.
(...I see. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is easy to read...)
Ooh, a pretty big one. Want to make one too while we take a break？
Let's work hard and make a big one！
This Japanese painting is so powerful. All that with just black ink...
(Huh, she's not listening. All right, then...)
...Hm？ W-What？ What's going on？ ...Have you been staring at me？
Yeah. There's a painting of a girl just my type that I can't take my eyes off.
...I'm not a painting. Geez... Look over there.
So many people... We might get separated.
...Yes. Sometimes you use little bits of magic, don't you？
That part of you too... No, never mind.
Landscape paintings are nice... Looking at them, it feels like I've traveled all over.
Next, a vacation in Nice. Departure！
Their eyes are all big and watery... So cute▼
So is ▲高嶺＊＊▲, with her sparkly eyes▼
I'm not reacting to that kind of teasing.
Then I'll wait, neck stretched out long, like a giraffe.
With necks that long, don't they get stiff？
Ah～, they might... Want to give one a massage？
Hehe, I'm good at massages, you know？ Papa falls asleep with his mouth wide open.
Someday, if I get the chance, I'll give you one▼
Would it react to a giant cat toy, I wonder？
Ah～... It might, but wouldn't finding one be hard？
I wonder if it'll roar？ Like in the movies, "Graaah！"
Ooh, that was good！ Do it again！
I don't want to go home today...
There are so many bunnies！ Hey, let's feed them more？ I want to hold one▼
Maybe petting zoos are actually really profound.
With the animals between us, we touch without thinking, right？ And everyone's smiling.
Even after a fight, I bet we'd forget all about it here.
(Yeah, I think she has a point...)
Picking swimsuits together is a little embarrassing, isn't it？
Hey, what kind do you like？
One-piece... Okay, got it. Which one should I...
The one you have on now
